subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should this PR be allowed to expose a gateway-drain enqueue bypass on the public plugin SDK ChannelRunQueue type, or must the bypass stay core-private?
rationale: The bypass changes a public plugin contract and affects the restart security/availability boundary, so automation should not decide that API direction implicitly.

options.title: Keep Bypass Private
options.body: Require the PR to preserve the public ChannelRunQueue contract and route restart-drain bypass through a core-owned internal seam with focused tests.

options.title: Approve Public Bypass
options.body: Explicitly accept the public SDK expansion and require documented constraints plus security-boundary proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Queue Persistence
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers prefer the broader persisted-queue work to own the gateway restart message-loss cluster.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Private
recommendation.body: Require the PR to preserve the public ChannelRunQueue contract and route restart-drain bypass through a core-owned internal seam with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns public plugin SDK and restart boundary ownership where recent history points to steipete as the strongest available area owner.
